text:
mina: Saw a customer report: quota widget briefly shows another org's counts after quick org switches.
rafa: Any logs or repro steps?
mina: repro in prod logs:
[2026-03-23T11:02:01Z] req=A1 GET /console/orgs/11/dashboard -> fragment=quota-v1
[2026-03-23T11:02:02Z] req=A2 GET /console/orgs/22/dashboard -> fragment=quota-v1
[2026-03-23T11:02:02Z] resp=A2 fragment.used=quota-v1 remaining=42 (expected 420)
jen: Root cause: edge fragment cache key is route+version only. No tenant dimension.
rafa: Short-term mitigation: flip quota-v1 to `Cache-Control: private` at CDN so edge won't serve cross-tenant responses.
mina: OK but we should audit all fragments that surface org state. This leak could be visual now but could expose quota/usage in other fragments.
jen: Longer-term: add feature flag `edge.tenant_cache_keys` and a fragment-level `tenant_scoped` flag. When true, cache key = route+version+orgId. Add a small TTL option for hot-switch smoothing.
ops: deploy-bot: started canary 6287654330 - job: console/fragment-private-hotfix.
edge-bot: canary update: `fragment_leak` -> 0, `fragment_cache_miss` spiked x5 for quota-v1 then normalized. No errors.
mina: follow-up: add telemetry `fragment_cache_tag{route,org}` and an alert `fragment_leak>0`. Also add linter rule to require `tenant_scoped` for fragments that touch org-scoped data.
rafa: schedule arch sync to decide header vs signed-token approach for tenant-keying across CDNs.
mina: filing incident note and will close this thread after 24h of clean telemetry.
